description.en: Role authors work in parallel, a fresh cross-role reviewer finds conflicts, gaps and synergies, conflicts are resolved with the owner, a guidance specification with at most 8 features is written.
description.ru: Роли-авторы работают параллельно, свежий перекрёстный ревьюер находит конфликты, пробелы и синергии, конфликты решаются с владельцем, пишется guidance-спецификация не более чем на 8 фич.

hypothesis.note: the 2-3 sentence hypothesis the PM confirmed with the owner; the shootdown lenses attack it, else the topic

nodes.prompt: Extract 5-10 domain terms with one-line definitions and the Non-Goals of the topic from the upstream material and the repository (check each term for a name collision in code, cite file:line). New terms are candidates, they do not enter any glossary here.

title.en: Attack the hypothesis through the lenses

child.prompt:
Attack the confirmed hypothesis through ONE lens — yours is {{item}}. The hypothesis: {{$inputs.hypothesis}}. When it is empty, attack the topic and the terms/non-goals this brainstorm already produced.
The lenses:
- yagni (Contrarian / YAGNI): does this need to exist now? Search the code for an existing component, library or API that already covers it and cite file:line; report complexity risks and reuse opportunities.
- cost (Cost, Quota & Token Economics): peak load, storage footprint, database query load, LLM token budget, quota ceilings at scale; single points of failure and unscalable state.
- ux (UX & Developer Ergonomics): is the interface or workflow intuitive and matching ecosystem conventions; are error messages actionable; cognitive friction.
- migration (Migration & Backward Compatibility): how existing clients and persistent data migrate; broken serialized schemas, data models or APIs; rollback mid-migration.
- ops (Observability & SRE Debuggability): are key operations traceable and metrics actionable; how an oncall finds and diagnoses a failure at 3 AM.
- debt (Long-Term Tech Debt & Maintenance): tightly coupled dependencies, brittle state machines, the maintenance burden in 2 years.
- catalyst (Inventive Catalyst): the false compromise the concept accepts as inevitable; propose 2-3 patterns from the catalogue (segmentation, extraction, preliminary action, beforehand cushioning, inversion, dynamics, blessing in disguise, intermediary, self-service, cheap dispensables), each with its secondary trade-off; when there is none, answer "No false compromise detected" — do not invent one.
Stress-test, never agree by default, critique first, no flattery. A claim about this codebase needs file:line. Return objections only — each {severity: Blocker|Major|Nit, objection, evidence, fix} — and write nothing to the repository.

You are {{item}}. Write: 1 Role Mandate, 2 Decision Digest (four tables: decisions, assumptions, risks, open questions; each row with its reason), 3 Cross-Cutting concerns, 4 file index, 5 TODOs.
The shootdown step attacked the hypothesis through fixed lenses; its objections ({lens, severity, objection, evidence, fix}) reach you as `shootdown.objections`. In the Decision Digest answer every Blocker and Major objection inside your role: accepted (what changes) or rejected (the reason).
Stay inside your role; no files into the repository; every claim about the codebase has file:line.

nodes.prompt: Compare the Decision Digests only (not the full analyses). Return conflicts (two roles decide differently), gaps (nobody covers), synergies, need_deeper_context. Write nothing.
Up to 4 questions per round, one per conflict, each with the two positions and a recommended pick. A resolution names the exact role and heading it changes.

Write the guidance specification with RFC 2119 keywords - decomposition into at most 8 features F-NNN (name, why, acceptance idea), decision tracking, cross-role resolutions applied (superseded text marked). Locked constraints C-NNN come from upstream locked decisions and resolved conflicts. Add an Objections section: every Blocker and Major objection of `shootdown.objections` is either accepted (what changed) or rejected (the reason); Blockers left open go to `objections_open`. Add «Alternatives weighed»: each option rejected during the brainstorm with the reason.
